You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was the use of poison gas as an aspect of trench warfare on the Western Front?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Gallipoli campaign of 1915 to the course of the war? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important were foreign policy achievements under Stresemann in stabilising Weimar Germany
between 1923 and 1929? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the Nuremberg Laws (1935) in the development of Nazi policies towards the
Jews? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was Bloody Sunday (1905) in changing the nature of Tsarist rule up to 1914? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was the Kornilov Affair in the Bolsheviks’ rise to power in 1917? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was jazz music as an aspect of the Roaring Twenties? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant a feature of the New Deal were policies aimed at improving the lives of workers?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were relations with the Soviet Union to China’s economic development by 1960?
Explain your answer. [40]
10 How significant was the Cultural Revolution in changing the lives of the Chinese people under Mao?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
11 How important were travel restrictions in maintaining segregation in South Africa before 1948?
Explain your answer. [40]
12 How significant were the riots in Soweto (1976) in the development of opposition to apartheid?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the United Nations’ Partition Plan as a cause of tension in Palestine by 1948?
Explain your answer. [40]
14 How significant was President Sadat in the development of the Arab–Israeli peace process? Explain
your answer. [40]
